_note: G7 LETHAL8 (G7_REFERENCE 13.9c-47, owner 2026-10-29: 'ALL should be as realistic as possible per round type and how fast it flys etc *** real bullet/round physics', lethality 'Realistic'). Read by sim/systems/ballistics8.gd from Damage.apply_hit (direct fire + splash). ALL NUMBERS PROVISIONAL. Round fields: v0 muzzle velocity m/s, mass_g projectile mass (energy = 0.5 m v^2, reported), k velocity loss per metre (v = v0 * exp(-k * metres)), pen armour penetration in mm RHA-equivalent at the muzzle (falls with the energy ratio (v/v0)^2 unless chem: shaped-charge / HEAT jets do not depend on velocity), wound = share of one unarmoured body a torso hit takes at the muzzle (falls with v/v0; the hit zone multiplier and the WOUND7 head / knock-out rules still apply), kill = share of a ground vehicle's design hp (units.json hp; side / rear hits x rules.armor_facing) one full penetration removes (AT weapons: 1-3 hits), nofall = explosive / indirect: no range falloff (splash falloff still comes from the weapon). Game ranges are compressed: m_per_tile_ballistic converts tiles to ballistic metres (a 6-tile rifle range is ~240 m). Armour classes: thickness t in mm RHA-equivalent and coverage cov (share of hits that strike the armour) per hit zone (soldiers) or avg (squads, Machine frames); blunt = share of the hit that still hurts when the armour stops the round; vehicles: t, kill_mult (light vehicles: an AT round through 14 mm is a catastrophic hit), blocked = share of the old damage left when the round does not penetrate. A round passes when pen >= 1.15 t (residual 1 - 0.3 t / pen), is stopped below 0.85 t, linear in between. Weapons not listed and weapon classes mapped to null keep the old G2 damage path (flame, melee, demolition, EMP / microwave / arc, nets, torpedoes, AA missiles vs ground).
